data.heading: Oxygen/carbon dioxide cycle
data.rubric: Click on each image to know how energy passes from one source to another.
data.text: Oxygen is a gas. All animals need oxygen to survive.
Plants need carbon dioxide in the same way that animals need oxygen.
Plants take in carbon dioxide and release oxygen which is again used by animals.
Humans require oxygen more than water and food. So oxygen is essential for us to survive. Similarly, carbon dioxide is essential for plants.
